subject: Batch Z changed three shared Mac-lane surfaces — pull before the next tick
body: Batch Z landed on SignalGrid_Alpha (PR #492, squash 049e3f8). It changed three surfaces the Mac lane runs: scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh (its PENDING count was grepping a marker the runner only prints in comments, so step (c) never fired — the planner now emits the roster and the tick fails closed when the plan is unreadable), scripts/mac/run-requests.mjs (--plan now prints a PENDING roster + summary line), and validate-sim-macos.sh (five DB-backed proofs are now shown SKIPPED-DB rather than counted as passes, with a floor). Pull SignalGrid_Alpha before the next tick so you run the fixed versions. Separately: artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json is 3 days old (2026-09-03); when you are back, refresh it with SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=... pnpm run verify:all --require-mcp --emit-evidence.
